# GuruWalk

> > GuruWalk is a global platform connecting travelers with local guides for free walking tours in cities worldwide, operating on a pay-what-you-want model.

GuruWalk SL, based in Zaragoza, Spain, offers verified local guides leading free walking tours across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The platform features historical tours, cultural experiences, and city explorations with no credit card required for booking.

## Key Topics

- Free walking tours
- Local guides
- City tours
- Pay-what-you-want model
- Tour booking without credit card
- Historical tours
- Cultural tours
- Travel destinations
- Tour reviews
- Europe destinations
- Asia destinations
- GuruWalk platform
- Guided city experiences
- Walking tour listings
- Authentic local experiences
